name: ButtonGroup
intent: Joined row of kit Buttons that share one size and act as one control cluster.
usage: Use a group for related actions that share one size, like a view switch, a cancel and save pair, or a toolbar. The group sets size and disabled for every Button inside it. Only kit Buttons go in a group. See contracts/buttongroup.json for the full contract.

label.note: Names the group for screen readers (aria-label).

size.note: Applied to every Button in the group. Buttons inside do not set their own size. Without a size it is md. A surrounding Density changes these sizes through the density tokens (Default values shown).

disabled.note: Disables every Button in the group.

children.note: Two or more kit Buttons. Nothing else.

useWhen: Related sibling actions, such as a view switch.
A cancel and confirm pair that should read as one cluster.
doNot: Do not invent a local button group or segmented control.
Do not mix sizes inside one group.
Do not put more than one primary Button in a group or the view.
Do not wrap Input, Select, or anything except kit Button.
Do not use for picking one option (a pressed button). Use Segmented.
Do not use for paging a list.
a11y: Each Button keeps its own name. Icon-only Buttons still need children as their label.

examples.title: Period switch
examples.usage: Related sibling actions that share one size. All secondary, so the group stays quiet.

examples.title: Confirm pair
examples.usage: Cancel and save as one cluster. This is the one primary Button for the view.

examples.title: Icon toolbar
examples.usage: Icon-only Buttons in one group. Each Button keeps a label for screen readers. Same size for all.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: Set size on the group, not on each Button. Pick the size that matches the controls around it.
